subject.title: [Bug]: Node invoke timeout semantics diverge across Gateway and node

question: Should the assigned maintainer sponsor this protected issue as the canonical narrow Gateway timeout-semantics fix now?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible and the fix shape is narrow, but the `maintainer` label and assignment mean cleanup automation should not close or dispatch it without explicit human handling.

options.title: Sponsor Narrow Gateway Fix
options.body: Normalize `node.invoke` timeout once and add focused Gateway/node-registry tests for zero and oversized values.

options.title: Fold Into Existing Timeout PR
options.body: Keep this issue open and require https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/92714 or a successor PR to explicitly cover zero/no-deadline and forwarded-clamp semantics.

options.title: Defer Protected Tracker
options.body: Leave this issue open without repair-lane dispatch until the assigned maintainer chooses the timeout contract.

recommendation.title: Sponsor Narrow Gateway Fix
recommendation.body: Normalize `node.invoke` timeout once and add focused Gateway/node-registry tests for zero and oversized values.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is assigned on GitHub and has the strongest recent history on the relevant Gateway/node registry path.
